soft watercolor picture-book illustration for young children, warm pastel colours, rounded friendly shapes, gentle golden light, clean uncluttered composition. Kavin walks happily towards a huge mango tree heavy with golden mangoes and lifts his trunk to pick the biggest one. Setting: a sunny green meadow with a big mango tree. Mood: bright and cheerful. Kavin the baby elephant: a small round baby elephant with soft blue-grey skin, big floppy ears with pink insides, a short curly trunk, bright curious eyes and a red-and-yellow striped scarf. Child-friendly composition with every character clearly visible. No text, no letters, no words, no signs.
